document_structure.content:
Template ID | FIN-GUAR-001
Category | Guarantees & guarantor agreements
Intended use | Third-party guarantee supporting specifically identified obligations; independent legal advice strongly recommended.

DRAFTING PLACEHOLDERS: Replace every {{...}} field, delete unused options, complete all schedules, and resolve all [SELECT]/[OPTIONAL] text before signature. Text in square brackets is an instruction, not an agreed term.
This GUARANTEE AND GUARANTOR AGREEMENT (the “Agreement”) is made on {EFFECTIVE_DATE} (the “Effective Date”) by and between {{PARTY_A_LEGAL_NAME}} and {{PARTY_B_LEGAL_NAME}}.
Each may be referred to as a “Party” and together as the “Parties”. The legal names, entity types, registration details and notice addresses of the Parties are set out below.

content.content:
Party A | {{PARTY_A_LEGAL_NAME}}; {{ENTITY_TYPE}}; registration no. {{REGISTRATION_NUMBER}}; address {{REGISTERED_ADDRESS}}; email {{NOTICE_EMAIL}}
Party B | {{PARTY_B_LEGAL_NAME}}; {{ENTITY_TYPE}}; registration no. {{REGISTRATION_NUMBER}}; address {{REGISTERED_ADDRESS}}; email {{NOTICE_EMAIL}}

document_structure.heading: BACKGROUND
content: A. The Parties wish to enter into the financial arrangement described in this Agreement.
B. Each Party confirms that it has authority to enter into and perform this Agreement, subject to the terms below.

document_structure.heading: 1. GUARANTEED OBLIGATIONS
content: Guarantor guarantees to Beneficiary the due and punctual payment and performance by {{PRINCIPAL_DEBTOR}} of the obligations expressly described in Schedule A (the “Guaranteed Obligations”) owed to {{CREDITOR}} under {{UNDERLYING_AGREEMENT}}.

document_structure.heading: 2. NATURE AND CAP
content: This is a {{PAYMENT GUARANTEE / PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE / OTHER}}. The Guarantor’s maximum aggregate liability is {{CURRENCY}} {{LIABILITY_CAP}}, including {{SPECIFY INTEREST/COSTS}}. No liability exceeds the cap or scope stated in this Agreement.

document_structure.heading: 3. DEMAND
content: A demand must be in writing, identify the default and amount claimed, include reasonable supporting particulars, and be delivered to the Guarantor’s notice address. Payment is due within {{DAYS}} days after a valid demand, subject to any defences that cannot lawfully be excluded.

document_structure.heading: 4. CONTINUING GUARANTEE AND VARIATIONS
content: This guarantee continues until {{EXPIRY_DATE / DISCHARGE_EVENT}}. It covers variations to the underlying obligations only where the Guarantor has expressly consented in writing to the relevant variation. No material increase in liability is implied.

document_structure.heading: 5. GUARANTOR REPRESENTATIONS
content: Guarantor confirms that it has capacity and authority, has received the underlying agreement and relevant financial information, understands the nature and maximum extent of liability, and has had the opportunity to obtain independent advice.

document_structure.heading: 6. SUBROGATION AND RECOVERY
content: Until the Guaranteed Obligations are irrevocably discharged, Guarantor shall not enforce contribution, reimbursement or subrogation rights in a manner that prejudices Beneficiary, to the extent such postponement is lawful. Any recovered amount shall be accounted for without double recovery.

document_structure.heading: 7. DISCHARGE AND RELEASE
content: Beneficiary shall release the Guarantor promptly after all Guaranteed Obligations are irrevocably paid and performed, subject to contingent obligations expressly listed in Schedule A.

document_structure.heading: 8. NO DOUBLE RECOVERY
content: Beneficiary may not recover more than the total amount of the Guaranteed Obligations actually due, together with lawful interest and recoverable costs within the cap.

document_structure.heading: . GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
content: This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising from it are governed by the laws of {{GOVERNING_JURISDICTION}}, excluding conflict-of-law rules to the extent permitted. The courts at {{COURT_VENUE}} shall have {{EXCLUSIVE/NON-EXCLUSIVE}} jurisdiction. [Alternative: disputes shall be finally resolved by arbitration seated at {{ARBITRAL_SEAT}}, under {{ARBITRATION_RULES}}, in {{LANGUAGE}}.] Select one dispute-resolution route and ensure it is legally available.

document_structure.heading: Notices must be in writing and delivered by hand, recognised courier or email to the addresses specified above (or updated by notice). An email notice is effective only upon {{DELIVERY/ACKNOWLEDGEMENT/OTHER AGREED EVENT}}.
. GENERAL
content: This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement on its subject matter and supersedes prior discussions. Any amendment must be in writing and signed by both Parties. Neither Party may assign this Agreement without the other Party’s prior written consent, except {{PERMITTED_ASSIGNMENTS}}. If any provision is invalid, the remaining provisions continue in effect. A failure to enforce a right is not a waiver. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by legally recognised electronic signature.

document_structure.heading: SIGNATURES
content: The Parties have caused this Agreement to be executed by their duly authorised representatives as of the dates set out below.

statutory_verification.heading: CLAUSECITE STATUTORY VERIFICATION — INTERNAL DRAFTER NOTES
content: Do not present these prompts as legal citations. Use the selected jurisdiction, transaction facts and current statutory corpus to retrieve and validate the applicable provisions. Insert verified citations into the relevant clauses only after retrieval.
Verify guarantee / suretyship formalities, consideration or deed requirements, execution, stamping and registration.
Check limits on guarantees by companies, directors, spouses or related parties and required corporate approvals.
Verify demand, insolvency, subrogation, limitation and consumer protection rules.
